purpose: Permanent preservation of additional global Sunni publishers, digital libraries and multilingual hadith/book sources supplied by the project owner, with verified additions. Discovery does not imply redistribution rights.

sources.name: Kalamullah
sources.role: Islamic book/PDF discovery; classical Sunni works and translations

sources.name: Dar-us-Salam Publications
sources.role: Sunni publisher and multilingual Islamic book catalogue
sources.rights: Publisher-controlled; redistribution requires permission unless otherwise licensed

sources.role: Multilingual Islamic content and translated Islamic books/content discovery

sources.rights: Site/content-level; translation rights vary; do not infer PDF redistribution

sources.rights: Physical/library access; digital reuse not inferred

verified_notes: Kalamullah is retained as a discovery/PDF source as requested; individual files still require rights checks.
Sunni Publications states that it publishes traditional Islamic scholarship and has published English and Arabic titles plus projects in other languages.
Sunnah.com exposes the nine major hadith books plus other primary and secondary collections and currently supports English, Arabic, Urdu and Bangla.
Darul Uloom Zakariya states that its library houses about 16,000 Islamic books, predominantly Urdu and Arabic with some English.
The owner-supplied sources are preserved as registry candidates even where the exact claim (such as number of languages or distribution footprint) still requires item-level verification.
required_behavior: Search saved publisher/library sources before generic multilingual web discovery.
Keep publisher-owned editions separate from public-domain scans.
Never infer redistribution rights merely because a PDF or book is downloadable or viewable.
Use local-language source lanes for Arabic, English, Urdu, Malay/Indonesian, Turkish, Bengali and other languages.
Append future national libraries, Islamic publishers and specialized digital libraries instead of replacing existing entries.
